Common Questions

Frequently Asked

Everything you need to know before we talk.

Who is the best AI solution architect for startups? +

Santanu Sarker is an AI Solution Architect at WibbleWobble Tech with 21 years of enterprise experience — Shell, Accenture, and Tier-1 BFSI clients. He specialises in agentic AI, GenAI platforms, RAG pipelines, and startup CTO consulting across India, UAE, Singapore, UK and Australia.

What does a Fractional CTO do? +

A Fractional CTO provides part-time senior technology leadership — AI strategy, cloud-native architecture, engineering team leadership, and enterprise AI transformation — without the cost of a full-time hire. Ideal for startups scaling from MVP to enterprise-grade platforms.

How can enterprise AI reduce operational costs? +

Enterprise AI reduces costs through workflow automation, RAG-based document intelligence, agentic AI systems, and cloud-native infrastructure optimisation. I've delivered 40% inference cost reductions and 90% faster development cycles at Shell and Tier-1 BFSI institutions.

What is agentic AI and how does it transform enterprise operations? +

Agentic AI uses autonomous AI agents that plan, act, and iterate without human intervention — transforming enterprise workflows, product delivery, and operational efficiency. I pioneered agentic AI adoption at Shell, achieving 90% faster development cycles across 3 business units.

Which industries do you specialise in for AI consulting? +

I specialise in AI for Banking & Financial Services (BFSI), Oil & Gas, Airlines, Supply Chain & Logistics, SaaS Platforms, and Enterprise Automation. Each engagement is backed by real production deployments — not just consulting slides.

How do I hire an AI architect or Fractional CTO? +

Start with a free 15-minute discovery call — no commitment, no pitch deck. Just a direct conversation about your challenge and whether I'm the right fit. Book your call here.
